name: sound-flags-we
description: Sound flags, dialogue words and the import list of new sounds against the WE's own save (branch sound-flags-we, 2026-11-15, SD; input make-sound-flags-input.mjs: random-group.w3m, no sounds, no import list; beep.wav a 0.25 s 16-bit mono tone). WE (Sound Editor, F5; File menu 109,131: Use As Sound 147,271, Replace Internal Sound 175,314; Import Sound Ctrl+I; the tree keeps its scroll and folders for the editor's session, so a click on a tree row and Home first, and the spec wants a freshly started editor or a run of its own): (1) Sound > Interface, its first file AchievementEarned.flac, Use As Sound; (2) Replace Internal Sound with beep.wav (the tree's file still selected); (3) Import Sound beep.wav (it shows at the tree's bottom, 177,864), Use As Sound; (4) Sound > Dialogue > Extra, its first file AAGAREK_Death1.ogg, Use As Sound. Studio: the same by the Sound Editor's Add as sound, w3.sounds.replace (file dialog and question stubbed), the Import Manager's Import files (stubbed), Add as sound from its Imported tab; the input's old war3map.j deleted so w3.script.generate writes. Same in WE and Studio (asserted): every new sound, the Dialogue one too, gets dialogueTextKey and speakerNameKey -1, dialogueText and speakerName empty, unknown1 0, unknown2 1 (the Sound Properties dialog has no dialogue, speaker or music fields, also for a Dialogue sound, so no keyed sound is made here); the imported file's sound gets flags 0x10 (16), the game ones 0; the imported file's list entry war3mapImported\beep.wav flags 21. Also asserted since branch sound-editor-we: paths with / (sounds' file and assetFile, CreateSound, the replaced file's list entry); Replace Internal Sound keeps the game's name (Sound/Interface/AchievementEarned.flac holding the .wav bytes) with list flags 21 at this save (13 at the next save after another change in the same session: exploration twice; opened again and saved, with or without a change, it stays 21); a labelled game sound takes the label's numbers, those equal to the game's defaults unset (fade 0, priority 1000, pitchVariance 1, AchievementEarned channel 8, maxDistance 0, minDistance 0 unset, distanceCutoff 10000, eaxEffect "0" written DefaultEAXON; AAGarek_Death1 volume 120, channel 0 written -1, minDistance 3000, maxDistance 10000 unset, distanceCutoff 100000; pitch 1 unset, coneOutsideVolume -1); the imported file's sound: fade 0, priority 100, coneOutsideVolume 127, assetFile its file; Studio's Imported tab shows the file imported while the Sound Editor is open (not closed and opened again here). Known differences in the script: the WE writes no SetSoundDuration (Studio 250, 250, 3583): its Length column reads 00:00.000 for every sound in this sandbox, a game map's (IceFlow) too, whose three SetSoundDuration it drops at a save, so this is not taken for the editor's rule; and the WE lists the sounds made in its session after the trigger's global (the global table's order: loaded sounds first, in the order they were loaded, kept through Move Up/Down; opened again they come before the trigger), which Studio's generator, made from the files alone, doesn't know. Stable on three WE runs. Expected OK (w3s and imp MATCH, the script DIFFERS)
